record.question: My new watch does not _____________ good time. Fill in the blank with the appropriate form of verb.
record.explanation: Answer A: keep. A watch “keeps good time.” Independent check: The idiom for a functioning watch is “keep good time.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/verbs-followed-by-prepositions-and-prepositions-followed-by-ing-forms; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
